Description: JobTrack HTTPS demo in the AWS Academy Cloud Architecting Sandbox.

SshCidr.Description: Single trusted client IPv4 /32 for SSH tunnel

Properties.GroupDescription: SSH only from one trusted client; app remains on loopback

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
dnf install -y python3.11 unzip
mkdir -p /opt/jobtrack /var/lib/jobtrack
aws s3 cp s3://${SourceBucket}/${SourceKey} /tmp/jobtrack.zip --region ${AWS::Region}
unzip /tmp/jobtrack.zip -d /opt/jobtrack
useradd --system jobtrack
chown jobtrack:jobtrack /var/lib/jobtrack
cat > /etc/systemd/system/jobtrack.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=JobTrack
After=network.target
[Service]
User=jobtrack
WorkingDirectory=/opt/jobtrack/JobTrack
Environment=JOBTRACK_DB=/var/lib/jobtrack/jobtrack.sqlite3
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3.11 server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
Restart=on-failure
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/jobtrack
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now jobtrack

Access.Value: HTTPS on the public IP's sslip.io hostname, protected by HTTP Basic authentication; SSH restricted to the trusted /32.
